thread:
clare: Quick round : we need micro-hero variants for hosted / dedicated / private. Focus: social card headlines (concise), landing hero (slightly longer), and exact CTA destinations for webinar vs signup. Keep social headlines <=9 words.

omar: Agreed. Also we should decide which metrics appear on the webinar CTA: demo-only vs demo+cost-estimate. I vote demo+quick-cost opt-in.

tess: For clarity: social -> card -> landing. Webinar clicks should always land on the demo page with a pre-filled interest checkbox. Signup clicks go to trial.

leo: Drafting a few micro-headlines now. Will post three per mode (performance, cost, control).

growth-bot: Upload: https://drive.redwood/marketing/micro-heroes-v2 (access: marketing).

leo: Hosted (short):
- "Build with a fast hosted LLM API"
- "Ship LLM features without infra work"
- "Fast responses, simple SDKs"

leo: Dedicated (short):
- "Reserved GPUs for predictable production"
- "Capacity you can count on"
- "Throughput-focused dedicated serving"

leo: Private (short):
- "Run inference inside your network"
- "On-prem or VPC: enterprise-ready"
- "Keep data on-prem, still scale"

clare: Nice. Swap in alternate verbs for variety: "Ship" -> "Launch" in one variant. Also keep one purely cost-led variant for Hosted: "Lower inference costs as you scale."

omar: Subcopy ideas (one-liners for landing): Hosted: "Hosted API with streaming, SDKs, and predictable pricing." Dedicated: "Dedicated GPU pools, autoscaling, and SLA-backed latency." Private: "Customer-managed networking, audit trails, and KMS support."

tess: CTA mapping (we need exact hrefs for ops):
- Hosted CTA -> /signup?utm=card_hero (self-serve trial)
- Dedicated CTA -> /contact/sales?utm=card_hero (AE intake)
- Private CTA -> /contact/private?utm=card_hero (security packet + AE)
- Webinar CTA -> /demo?utm=webinar_card (demo queue & cost opt-in)
Include hidden field campaign=mini_hero_launch.

leo: Web copy experiments: Variant P (performance) and Variant C (cost). Social split 60/40 in favor of performance for first run. Run 10 days.

clare: For webinar CTAs use label "See demo & pricing". On the landing, make the demo page CTA "See performance in action" and a smaller link "Request cost estimate" (optional checkbox).

omar: Legal/usability: Private page microcopy under CTA: "Inputs remain within your network; Redwood does not retain content." Legal OK provided token.

tess: Forms: add hidden tags source=social_card, experiment=mini_hero_v2, variant=performance|cost. CRM mapping: demo_interest -> solutions-team, trial_signup -> auto-onboard, sales_lead -> AE-queue.

leo: Example social post copy for builders: "Launch LLM features faster with Redwood Try the hosted API or join our demo to see real benchmarks. #llm #developers"

clare: Slide deck: one micro-benchmark (latency p50/p95 vs concurrency) + one cost delta slide (starter hosted vs dedicated). Keep numbers illustrative, not absolute.

growth-bot: Playbook updated: https://drive.redwood/playbooks/mini-hero-routing (edited by tess). Experiment created in Growth Console: id gh-mini-2026, start 2026-07-10 09:00 UTC.

omar: Action items: leo to push copy variants to staging, tess to update playbook forms, clare to draft social post schedule, growth-bot to start experiment. Check-in Wed for visual QA.

clare: Perfect. Add note: tag webinar signups in CRM with tag "webinar_minihero_v2". We'll evaluate CTR, demo conversion, and cost-estimate requests after 72 hours. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
